content:
Tom Reyes: spotted a duplicate settlement for AWS invoice AWS-2211 — looks like reseller was charged twice this morning. Can billing ops confirm?
billing-bot: events: invoice=AWS-2211 payment_ref=pay_9a8b size=9842.50 USD; duplicate event detected payment_ref=pay_9a8c size=9842.50 USD; webhook ids differ.
Anika Patel: do we have two settlement files or a retry? Exchange rates show one entry converted to EUR which caused GL mismatch.
partnerops-bot: reached out to partner ops, partner says they accidentally re-submitted same invoice with new settlement_id — they voided duplicate on their side and asked us to refund immediately.
Finance-approvals-bot: policy check: refunds >$500 require FinOps sign-off. Requesting manual approval.
Anika Patel: approving provisional refund of $9,842.50 USD (will cap/reverse if partner confirms void). Ticket #5122. :white_check_mark:
Tom Reyes: created refund transaction REF-665 with status=pending, noted reason="duplicate settlement from partner". Will wait for partner confirmation then reconcile FX differences.
billing-bot: ledger update queued: `INSERT INTO refunds (ref_id,invoice,amount,currency,status) VALUES ('REF-665','AWS-2211','9842.50','USD','pending');`
Anika Patel: once partner confirms void, we'll mark refund complete and run `UPDATE invoices SET status='refunded' WHERE invoice_id='AWS-2211';`
Tom Reyes: closing loop — partner confirmed reversal at 2026-05-10T14:02Z. Marking refund complete and reconciling FX.
billing-bot: refund REF-665 status=completed, FX adjustment posted. Ticket #5122 closed.
